chunks: And the Imam (peace be upon him) said:
"Be good to your parents, and your children will be good to you. Remain chaste concerning the women of others, and your women will remain chaste."

key_terms.بَرُّوا: Be good to / show kindness to
key_terms.نِسَاءِ النَّاسِ: The women of others / other people's wives
key_terms.يَبَرَّكُمْ: They will be good to you / show kindness to you

ai.seo_question: What is the connection between treating parents well and children's behavior according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) articulates a profound principle of reciprocal justice (mu'atabah) within the family structure, linking filial piety to offspring's devotion and marital chastity to spousal fidelity. This hadith, found in Al-Saduq's *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih*, underscores that moral integrity in one's conduct toward others directly influences the moral state of one's own household, serving as a practical guide for maintaining social and familial stability in Shia ethical tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4985 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Be good to your parents, and your children will be good to you. Remain chaste concerning the women of others, and your women will remain chaste."
